tool_args.rationale: The pilot indicates a damped fast transient, but all five paid rows share H = 3.6. A discriminating horizon measurement is needed to identify whether the apparently near-static response persists across time.

considered_alternatives.option: Static linear or adiabatic relaxation model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations are all at the same horizon and are nearly proportional to u_now, so they do not distinguish a static response from a damped transient or a slower relaxation.
The principal ambiguity is horizon dependence, which the slow-horizon probe directly tests.
Resolving fine transient structure is less directly relevant to the long-horizon prediction.
It does not address the identified mechanism ambiguity.
